# Salad

Type: Food | Internal ID: Salad | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Jotun puffs x3, Onion x3, Cloudberries x3 | Max Health: 26 | Max Stamina: 80 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

# Introduction

Salad is a Mistlands-tier food.

## Availability

Three salads are produced in a level 5 Cauldron with:
• 3 Jotun puffs
• 3 Onion
• 3 Cloudberries

## Notes

• Salad provides the fewest bonuses of the stamina-focused foods in the Mistlands tier, but it is easy to produce in bulk - requiring farmable Jotun puffs and Onions and easily-gatherable Cloudberries. Additionally, each batch of this recipe yields three salads, whereas the other Mistlands stamina food recipes (Mushroom omelette and Fish 'n' bread) yield only one each.
